# Best 65W GaN chargers for a laptop and phone

**My pick: Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W, A2667)**, $29.99 at Newegg: [buy here](https://www.newegg.com/p/359-00D8-002C3)

- It has two USB-C ports and one USB-A, and it uses GaN II and PPS ([Anker spec page](https://service.anker.com/product-description/a085g000004x2BVAAY)).
- A single port delivers the full 65W, enough for a MacBook Air, Dell XPS 13 or ThinkPad.
- With a laptop and a phone plugged in, it splits 45W + 20W across the two USB-C ports. With all three ports in use, it drops to 40W / 12W / 12W.
- It's about the size of an AirPods Pro case and has foldable prongs. Laptopbee ranks the Anker 65W 3-port as its [Editor's Choice](https://www.laptopbee.com/best-65w-usb-c-chargers/).
- Cables aren't included.

## Alternatives

- **Baseus Enercore 67W (CJ11), about $29.99.** Tom's Hardware picked it as the [best 65W-range charger](https://www.tomshardware.com/peripherals/usb/best-usb-chargers). It held full wattage throughout testing and ran the coolest of the group. It has a built-in retractable USB-C cable plus two more USB-C ports, so you can leave the cable at home.
- **UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W.** [Smart Gadget Kit](https://smartgadgetkit.com/best-gan-charger/) names it best overall. It weighs 113g, has three ports, and ships with US, UK and EU plug heads, which suits international travel. It splits 45W + 20W with two devices. I didn't see a price in the results, so check the current one.
- **Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W 2-pack, $49.99.** It has PPS for Samsung Galaxy fast charging. Buying two lets you keep one at home and one in your bag. See the [listing](https://dealectric.com/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u), which is an affiliate page. With multiple devices connected, the laptop port drops to 45W.

## Things to know

- Every 65W multiport charger shares its power. Once your phone is also plugged in, the laptop port gets roughly 40–45W. That's fine for a MacBook Air or similar, but a 65W-hungry laptop will charge more slowly. If you have a 14" or 16" MacBook Pro or a gaming laptop, consider a 100W charger instead.
- If you have a Samsung phone, the Anker spec page lists PPS support. One reviewer says the Anker lacks it, so the manufacturer's spec and the review conflict. The Baseus GaN5 Pro is the safer choice if Samsung Super Fast Charging matters to you.
- Prices change, so confirm at checkout.
